input_audit.scope: Long-double rational DC/contrast and independently reconstructed ADC codes/FP32 normalization, every target/phase/site; CFA/WB/matrix/zero variance/ROI/exposure checked. Does not prove restoration quality or independence of conditions from one source.

primary_audit.scope: All retained material methods/CFAs and published native cells, independently recomputed. Real low-ISO and native-binned references remain approximate; no real-reference PSNR or model recommendation.

contrast_pixel_audit.scope: Every actual saved native160 panel reread and independently rendered with long-double channel reductions and algebraic40x-minus39DC contrast. Shared previously audited NumPy Malvar preview only. Primary scores/normal-contrast triplets remain separate.

source_strata.scope: Descriptive original-target detail strata, defined by existing DCT16/luminance/gamut/RMS rules before the.025 contrast transform. Identical target-only masks across all methods/CFAs; no output-based mask or inference fitting. Derived after V120/V129 outputs and before V130 outputs, not an independent photographic validation or predeclared significance study.
